projects.title: MAGTK
projects.description: An ecommerce website for MAGTK, combining WordPress development with a custom plugin tailored to the store’s requirements.

projects.title: Caravan Concierge
projects.description: A business application built with Laravel and Tailwind CSS for managing Caravan Concierge’s operations across multiple locations, with a dashboard for revenue and occupancy, CRM, customer agreements, and reporting.

projects.title: DL Tickets
projects.description: A WordPress event ticketing website with a custom plugin for interactive seat plans, helping visitors explore seating sections, check seat prices, and select seats for their event.

projects.title: Ashbury Service Center
projects.description: A car servicing booking system for Ashbury Service Center, connected to the MechanicDesk platform through an API. Its calendar helps customers find available dates and book the services their vehicle needs.

projects.title: Book My Mechanic
projects.description: A WordPress website for Book My Mechanic, presenting its online booking solution for mechanic workshops with information on how it works, pricing, frequently asked questions, and getting started.

projects.title: Prime Capital
projects.description: A WordPress website for Prime Capital, presenting its equipment leasing services and helping businesses explore leasing options, resources, and application information.

projects.title: Ever Active Schools
projects.description: A WordPress website for Ever Active Schools, bringing together programs, events, educational resources, and ways to support healthier futures for children and youth.

projects.title: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology
projects.description: A university website built with Laravel and Vue.js, bringing together academic programs, admissions information, campus updates, and resources for students, faculty, and alumni.

projects.title: Instagrabber
projects.description: A Django application for extracting and downloading Instagram content, with a URL-based interface for photos, videos, reels, profile images, stories, and highlights.

projects.title: TikTokGrabber
projects.description: A web application for downloading TikTok videos and stories, with a simple URL-based interface that lets users paste a link and download their content.
